about.title: A studio that ships products
about.subtitle: Northline exists to build digital products that grow businesses — not to decorate decks.
about.metaDesc: Northline is a modern product partner combining design, software, technology, and digital growth.
about.heroBody: We unite design, engineering, technology, AI, and digital growth in one language. Northline is a brand’s digital product partner.
about.whoTitle: A modern digital product and technology partner.
about.whoBody: Northline does not split interface from code, or strategy from delivery. A small, disciplined team works remote-first — with weekly demos and written decisions.
about.whoQuote: Business problem first. Experience second. Software third.
about.approachTitle: From idea to a working product.
about.approachBody: We run strategy, design, engineering, and growth as one team — from the brief to the live product.

approachSteps.title: Strategy
approachSteps.body: We lock the goal, the user, the constraints, and the first delivery slice together.

approachSteps.title: Design
approachSteps.body: Flows, interface, and system. Usable, consistent, and ready to engineer.

approachSteps.title: Build
approachSteps.body: Engineering with performance and maintainability first. Weekly demos, visible progress.

approachSteps.title: Grow
approachSteps.body: After launch: measurement, SEO, automation, and product iteration — for as long as the product is live.

values.title: Clarity
values.body: Scope, decisions, and next steps are written. Visible progress — not surprise process.

values.title: Craft
values.body: Typography, space, and interaction are not accidents. The interface carries how the product thinks.

values.title: Ownership
values.body: Code, content, and accounts belong to the client. Handoff is part of delivery.

values.title: Measurability
values.body: Motion and 3D appear only when they clarify the product. Performance is not decoration.

about.whyTitle: Design and engineering in one language.
about.whyLead: Most teams find either a visual or a technical partner. We keep both at the same table.

whyItems.title: Product studio

whyItems.title: Integrated disciplines

whyItems.title: Honest scope

whyItems.title: Durable delivery
whyItems.body: Accessibility, speed, and care are delivery criteria — not later polish.

about.ctaTitle: Let’s leave a mark in digital — together.

about.whyBody: Too many companies get either design or engineering. They need one partner speaking both languages. That is why Northline exists.
about.howBody: Remote-first, weekly demos, written decisions. A small, disciplined team on the same side as the client.
about.qualityBody: Accessibility, performance, and maintainability are part of delivery — not afterthought polish.
